\tikzset{
  every picture/.style={color=red,line width=8pt,x=6pt,y=4pt,xshift=5pt},
  every on background layer/.style={draw=blue,fill=green,line width=2pt,xshift=3pt},
  layer ink/.style={draw=red,fill=white,line width=3pt,yshift=2pt}
}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw (0,0) -- (1,1);
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4pt,on background layer={layer ink},line width=9pt,draw=green]
    \draw (1,1) -- (2,2);
    \fill (3,0) rectangle (4,1);
  \end{scope}
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
    \draw (5,1) -- (6,2);
    \fill (7,0) rectangle (8,1);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \draw (9,1) -- (10,2);
    \fill (11,0) rectangle (12,1);
  \end{scope}
  \draw (13,0) -- (14,1);
\end{tikzpicture}
